info.title: Stophy API
info.description: API for YouTube research workflows and agents. Search videos, get transcripts, read comments, inspect channels, fetch playlists, and return structured JSON.

post.description: Fetch video details, transcript, comments, replies, or live chat. Pass type: details for metadata, transcript for timestamped captions, comments for top-level comments, replies for a comment thread (pass the repliesToken from a comment as continuationToken), or livechat for live stream chat messages.

type.description: The type of data to retrieve.

sortBy.description: Comment sort order: any (YouTube's default ordering), top, or latest. Only applies when type is 'comments'. Defaults to any.

chatType.description: Live chat mode. Only applies when type is 'livechat'. 'top' = Top chat (moderated, default), 'live' = all messages. Applied on the first call; later polls keep the chosen mode.

lang.description: Preferred transcript language code. Only applies when type is 'transcript'.

continuationToken.description: Pagination token. For 'livechat', pass the continuationToken from a previous livechat response to poll for new messages.
The repliesToken from a previous comments response.

data.description: Per-type response payload. See oneOf branches. If the operation yields no results, the response may include a `data.empty` object instead of the expected payload: `{ code: string, message: string }`. Codes: `EMPTY_TRANSCRIPT_SEGMENTS`, `EMPTY_COMMENTS`, `EMPTY_COMMENT_REPLIES`.

503.description: Transient upstream failure (UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE). YouTube was unreachable or bot-checked; the credit is refunded. Retry the request.

post.description: Retrieve channel metadata and content by channelUrl. Use the tab field to switch between videos, Shorts, live streams, playlists, community posts, courses, and about info. Set query to search within the channel.

channelUrl.description: Full YouTube channel URL, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/@mkbhd.

tab.description: Content tab to fetch. Defaults to video.

query.description: Search query within the channel. When supplied, tab is ignored.

continuationToken.description: Token from a previous response to fetch the next page.

sortBy.description: Sort order for the selected tab.

data.description: All tabs return the same top-level fields. For `tab: "about"`, `items` is empty, `continuationToken` is null, and `hasMore` is false. When a content tab has no items, the response also includes `data.empty`.

channel.description: The channel profile. Always returned for the 'about' tab; may be null on continuation requests for other tabs.

url.description: Canonical URL alias for the channel.

subscriberCount.description: Parsed subscriber count as a number.

subscriberCountText.description: Formatted subscriber count string as displayed on YouTube (e.g. '21M subscribers').

videoCount.description: Parsed total video count as a number.

isVerified.description: Whether the channel has a verification badge.

country.description: Channel country from the About tab; null when unavailable or on other tabs.

joinedDate.description: Date the channel was created; null when unavailable or on other tabs.

viewCount.description: Total channel view count from the About tab; null when unavailable or on other tabs.

viewCountText.description: Formatted total view count from the About tab; null when unavailable or on other tabs.

links.description: External links from the About tab; null when unavailable or on other tabs.

items.description: Tab-specific items. Shape varies by `tab`; empty for `tab: "about"`.

hl.description: Language code, e.g. en, fr, de. Defaults to en.

gl.description: Country code, e.g. US, GB, DE. Defaults to US.

post.description: Search YouTube Music, fetch suggestions, song metadata, lyrics, albums, artists, and playlists. The `type` request field selects the operation.

q.description: Search or suggestion query. Required for type search and suggest.

searchType.description: Music search result type. Used only when type is search.

videoUrl.description: YouTube / YouTube Music video URL or bare video ID. Required for type song and lyrics.

albumUrl.description: YouTube Music album URL or bare MPRE/OLAK album ID. Required for type album.

artistUrl.description: YouTube Music artist URL or bare UC/MPAD artist ID. Required for type artist.

playlistUrl.description: YouTube / YouTube Music playlist URL or bare playlist ID. Required for type playlist.

continuationToken.description: Token from a previous music search or playlist response.

videoUrl.description: YouTube Kids / YouTube video URL or bare video ID. Required for type video.

continuationToken.description: Token from a previous YouTube Kids search response.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Time window: 'today', the last 7 days, or the last 30 days.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: Timezone offset in minutes used to bucket activity into days. Defaults to UTC.

get.description: Return recent API request logs for the authenticated key.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Time window: 'today', the last 7 days, or the last 30 days.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: Filter logs to a single endpoint, e.g. /video.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page index. Page size is fixed at 50 entries.

total.description: Total number of matching log entries.

page.description: Zero-based page index that was returned.

endpoints.description: Distinct endpoints seen for this account, useful for building filters.

post.description: Streamable HTTP MCP transport. Auth via Authorization: Bearer st_<key> header. Use this with MCP clients like Cursor or Claude Desktop. Each tool call costs 1 credit except stophy_get_credits which is free.
